title: Data Attribution Should Steer Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.19698v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretraining data curation decides what a model learns from, yet what makes a document worth learning from depends on what the model already knows. Influence-driven selectors already rank documents to improve one run; we argue that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by identifying testable data properties that become reusable curation criteria, evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost, discovery included. A document ranking is consumed by the run it was computed for, whereas an explained data property can be tested across corpora and checkpoints, especially where familiar quality signals diverge from measured usefulness. Because historical contribution, an understandable explanation, and future data value require distinct evidence, we specify a feedback loop that interprets attributed sources, tests candidate data changes, and states for five claim types what evidence each requires and what n

translated_title: 数据归因应当引导预训练
translated_abstract: 预训练数据筛选决定了模型从什么数据中学习，然而一个文档是否值得学习取决于模型已经掌握了什么。基于影响力的选择器已经能够对文档排序以改进单次训练；我们主张训练数据归因应当通过识别可检验的数据属性来引导预训练，这些属性可以转化为可复用的筛选标准，并在总成本（包括发现成本）对齐的条件下，在新数据上与更廉价的选择器进行评估比较。文档排序只会被为其计算的那一次训练所消耗，而一个被解释清楚的数据属性则可以在不同语料库和模型检查点上进行检验，尤其是在人们熟悉的质量信号与实测有用性相背离的场景中。由于历史贡献、可理解的解释以及未来的数据价值各自需要不同的证据，我们规定了一个反馈回路：该回路解释归因来源、测试候选的数据变更，并针对五种论断类型说明每种论断分别需要什么样的证据以及什么样的……
tldr: 本文提出训练数据归因不应只服务于单次训练的文档排序，而应通过发现可在跨语料库、跨检查点检验的可复用数据属性（筛选标准）来持续引导预训练数据筛选，并为此设计了带证据规范（针对五类论断）的闭环流程。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by discovering reusable, testable data properties as curation criteria—evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost—rather than merely ranking documents for a single run, and it specifies a feedback loop with defined evidence requirements for five claim types.
